Mavericks 116Jazz 114

Flagg's free throws hold off Utah's 16–0 run

Final · Sun, Nov 22 · Utah

Dallas beat Utah 116–114, a 2-point road win. The Mavericks move to 10–7; the Jazz fall to 3–15.
